payload.headline: Big sprint — shipped 5 substantive changes, headlined by typed context-meter evidence.
bullets: **Typed context-meter evidence** — `scripts/lib/context-meter-consumer.mjs` validates producer JSON independently of mapped routing status and preserves honest null usage.

**Operational consumer convergence** — startup, standalone gauge, /go preview, sprint gate, boot amortization, skill-cost, token-budget, and round-budget paths share the typed semantics; an adoption sentinel prevents regrowth.
**Capability-map control plane** — Studio Ops and local capability maps merge low-to-high with local precedence, source diagnostics, and no secret-value output.

**Bounded stale-script evidence** — one tracked-file index plus one Git history stream replaces process-per-script scans; self/binary/size/fallback provenance, reversible attic moves, and SHA-256 receipts are executable.

**Monotonic arc profile parity** — local safety is compared against the authoritative profile, weakening is advisory/sibling-owned, and exact evidence `9098db0687e3d43ccdd4152183f7eec53ac9ffd206f8093ed14e6b4320e90565` was routed as signed Ark cargo `01JV7PAAGBB49A38E5F38F566A`.
